scope: 294 canonical scene entity behaviors and hooks; no gameplay/E2E completion is implied
graphRule: Reachability follows every transition target from initial plus all cursorHandoff destination roots. Same-activation cycles use continue/to edges over every reachable state; stay/restart/advance end an activation and are not loop edges.
conversionRule: Only the six allowlisted interactive perCommand flows: follow initial/continue in graph order; require all nodes visited once, a sole terminal restart, no external handoff endpoint and no noninitial entry; preserve body bytes, initial ID and optional initial entry; emit one stage without next. Never apply to auto or transition cadence.
capabilityGaps: Auto stages insert 100ms after every command and control wrapper; transition machines only wait at explicit to edges. Nested branch/loop lowering changes timing unless cadence is redesigned explicitly.
loop.maxIterations is a safety ceiling, not fixed repeat count; exhaustion throws. Compact finite repetition has no local count form.
Stage.next has no conditional/command-result choice. Some confirm decisions can be structured inside a step, but conditional future activation targets require a unified-step design.
32 external cursor-handoff endpoints expose implementation states across behaviors; conversion must rewrite each caller/callee family together, not rename cursor kinds.
moveEntity also changes gait/facing and offers discrete speeds; constant-pose nudge effects cannot be blindly rewritten as walking.
